title: Too Many Ads!
description: Adds ads that allow you to buy stuff!
body:
This mod adds ads! You can find ads in structures called "glitches". To make a computer combine iron, stone slabs, and, an err0r block (you can find them in glitches). When an add is crafted with a computer it gives you a computer that can buy stuff with diamonds or iron.
You can buy three things, a stick, a Herobrine plushie, and a Freddy plushie. There are also three ads you can find.
